# Poe2HotkeyObservation

[API index](../index.md)

Live state for one typed hotkey gesture. Clones share one coordinator subscription; dropping
or stopping the last handle releases its physical registration.

## IsAvailable

```typescript
IsAvailable: boolean;
```

False until the coordinator has delivered the first physical baseline, and after Stop.

## IsDown

```typescript
IsDown: boolean | null;
```

Current physical state, or null before the first baseline / after Stop.

## Stop

```typescript
Stop(): void;
```

Stops the observation and releases its physical subscription.
